subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should the pinned PR-limit announcement remain open as the public policy notice now that CONTRIBUTING.md and automation also enforce the 20-PR cap?
rationale: Current source and release evidence prove the policy is implemented, but the issue was deliberately reopened and pinned by a maintainer afterward, so closing it would change the repository's public communication posture rather than clean up missing code work.

options.title: Keep Pinned And Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the live policy notice while the docs and automation remain the enforceable source of truth.

options.title: Unpin And Close As Implemented
options.body: Close this issue only if maintainers decide CONTRIBUTING.md is enough public notice for the PR-limit policy.

options.title: Replace With A New Notice
options.body: Open or publish a fresh policy announcement and then close this issue with a pointer to the replacement.

recommendation.title: Keep Pinned And Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the live policy notice while the docs and automation remain the enforceable source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman made the 20-cap docs alignment and later reopened and pinned this exact issue, so they are the best visible owner for the policy-notice decision.
